district.name: Kai Tak
district.description: Kai Tak Outline Zoning Plan S/K22/9 planning scheme area (Planning Department, published 2026-07-17). Served by the government-run Kai Tak District Cooling System. Not an administrative district: it straddles Kowloon City and Kwun Tong districts.

area_definition.assignment_rule: footprint area-centroid (EPSG:2326 metres) inside the area polygon; no names or workbooks used

sources.licence_note: HK-BFETD v1.1: CC BY 4.0 according to the Zenodo record cited in the earlier preparation report. Not verified from the files themselves: confirm at the source and credit the dataset authors. Footprint licence for Lands Department derived geometry is unconfirmed.
